headline: Rodri to Real Madrid: two outlets, still just a rumour
paragraphs: The best-corroborated story of the day is Rodri's future. BBC's gossip column and Sky Transfers, reporting independently, both say Real Madrid are working on a deal to sign the Manchester City midfielder, with BBC describing Madrid as confident. Nothing here is confirmed by either club, and it remains a transfer rumour, but two separately-run outlets landing on the same claim is a stronger signal than most items in today's feed, where a single unattributed gossip column is the norm.

Arsenal are named in two separate, single-source reports. Sky says the club are exploring a deal for Real Madrid winger Vinicius Junior. A separate BBC gossip item has Arsenal eyeing John Stones and Ezri Konsa, in a column built around Real Madrid's own reported willingness to sell Aurelien Tchouameni to Manchester United. Neither story is corroborated elsewhere in the feed, so treat both as a name doing the rounds rather than anything advanced.

Liverpool's line is a single BBC gossip item saying the club are confident of signing Bradley Barcola; an earlier item in the same feed identifies Barcola as a Paris Saint-Germain player Liverpool have already made contact over, though nothing is confirmed. Manchester City are separately linked with Chelsea's Pedro Neto per Sky, but that story ran under two Sky-branded outlets rather than an independent second source, so it counts as one report, not two.
